Readiness gate PASS. sprint-status.yaml is unchanged: the one orphan, 3-2-the-pi-adapter, keeps its key per the approved 2026-10-25 proposal. No context file was written, because Epic 6 has open questions; Epic 5 has none.
Epic 6
- Story 6.4: Coordinator unit records (planning, retro, retro-item, reconcile) are journaled with `result: null` today, so "result `done`, of every unit kind" counts only Story units. Readings: (a) count records as journaled: coordinator units never count, and the coordinator's agent/model row shows 0 units done; (b) 6.4 makes the coordinator journal its session's result (planning and retro-item `done`, a validated retro as `done`; `reconcile` runs no session), so those units count from then on.
- Story 6.4: The journal records `loopbacks` but not whether a review ran or passed, so "units whose first review passed" has no field to read. Readings: (a) `loopbacks` 0 counts as a first-pass pass, so a `done` unit that never reached review (a write-check park, or a crash before review) counts as passed; (b) 6.4 adds a journal field for the first review's verdict, and the rate counts only reviewed units (planning:status.2's no-new-field decision covered review cost only).
